items.question: What exact OPSEC match policy and redaction policy can be published to implementers?

items.risk: A vague implementation may overblock or leak protected material.

items.question: Which authorization evidence classes and assurance thresholds are accepted per protected action and resource?
items.why_unresolved: Hosts differ, protected acceptance policy is not public, and the current service contract is absent.
items.risk: False authorization or unusable security gates.
items.what_future_assignment_can_resolve_it: Security-authorized Auth policy assignment, with BC-020 mapping only host-observable evidence

items.question: Which routes and owner policies form the first executable slice?
items.why_unresolved: BC-018 defines generic ownership but does not authorize a concrete runtime route catalog.

items.question: What deterministic tooling, if any, can verify natural-language claim-to-source support?
items.why_unresolved: A structured policy does not make semantic claim extraction deterministic.
items.risk: False determinism or unsupported source-only output.
items.what_future_assignment_can_resolve_it: Source-grounding verifier research and evaluation assignment

items.question: What are the exact capability freshness and invalidation rules per provider?
items.why_unresolved: Generic scope is defined but host lifecycle evidence belongs to BC-020.

items.question: Which host delivery, artifact, time, scheduling, and tool receipts can Chat and Codex actually provide?
items.why_unresolved: No host-specific adapter work is authorized in BC-018.
items.risk: Adapter contract may promise unobservable proof.

items.question: What continuity conflict, retention, deletion, and provenance lifecycle will Local Mirror implement?
items.why_unresolved: BC-018 defines only the generic provider boundary.

items.question: Does any public mood/profile context earn storage beyond evidenced current-turn or host_session input?
items.why_unresolved: Useful expression does not prove a need for stored or durable state.

items.question: What minimal classroom state, if any, should be specified after teaching behavior is proven?
items.why_unresolved: School archaeology shows value and risk but no approved state schema.
items.risk: Recreating School Engine or unsafe authority/state coupling.

items.question: Which current-source gaps should later successor implementations deliberately resolve versus leave unsupported?
items.why_unresolved: BC-018 classifies only gaps needed for boundaries and does not silently repair all 28.

items.what_future_assignment_can_resolve_it: Per-component implementation packets with explicit gap mapping

items.question: What protected finite maximum-attempt value, lockout/backoff rule, cancellation/reset rule, and new-request-after-exhaustion policy applies to each authorization interaction?
items.why_unresolved: BC-018-C1 requires a finite positive policy-supplied bound and fail-closed exhaustion but must not publish protected security values.
items.risk: An implementation could weaken the mandatory public repetition bound or disclose protected policy details.

items.question: Which Chat and Codex provider receipts and host-specific mechanics can prove host_session identity, request binding, freshness, expiry, and replay rejection?
items.why_unresolved: BC-018-C1 defines the generic evidence contract but host-specific capability mapping belongs to BC-020.
items.risk: An adapter could accept string correlation or conversation history as security state evidence.
items.what_future_assignment_can_resolve_it: BC-020 under the approved generic host-session contract
